article.title: Conciliator not bound by certain enactments.
article.content: The conciliator is not bound by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908) or the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (1 of 1872).
article.html:
66Conciliator not bound by certain enactments.

Section 66 · Part III · page 36 of the Act

The conciliator is not bound by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908) or the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (1 of 1872).
